summary: Lunasco is an interactive digital space museum that brings attention to abandoned and inactive space exploration equipment. It showcases historic lunar and Martian missions, including Apollo experiments, Surveyor 3, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity and InSight. Through mission photographs, interactive image viewing, animations and educational stories, Lunasco helps visitors explore the history, discoveries and scientific legacy of these robotic explorers. Our goal is to make space exploration history more engaging and accessible, reminding people that even when a mission ends, its contribution to science is never forgotten.
details:
What does Lunasco do?

Lunasco is a web-based interactive space museum designed to preserve and showcase the stories of abandoned and inactive space exploration equipment. It focuses on historical missions to the Moon and Mars and explains the purpose, discoveries and scientific contributions of these explorers.

How does it work?

The website organizes missions into an interactive archive. Visitors can explore mission cards, search for specific explorers, filter missions by the Moon or Mars, view photographs, read mission stories and explore a historical timeline.

What benefits does it provide?

Many people know about famous space missions but are less familiar with the robotic explorers and scientific instruments that remain on other worlds after their missions end. Lunasco makes this information easier to discover and understand, especially for students and space enthusiasts.

Intended impact

Our aim is to increase public awareness of space exploration history, encourage interest in planetary science and preserve the scientific legacy of machines that helped humanity explore beyond Earth.

Tools and technologies

The project was developed using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. ChatGPT was used as an AI-assisted development tool to help with website code, content drafting and improvements to the design and functionality.

Creativity

Lunasco combines a colorful space-themed interface, interactive mission archive, photographs, image viewing and animations to transform historical space exploration information into an engaging digital experience.
